item.case_name: Mood or music piece, no dialogue
item.title: Neon City on the Beat

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen night-city montage with an original upbeat electronic music bed. Show neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections; cut between them on the beat. No talking, singing or added text.

item.tests: Tests whether the final montage includes an instrumental music bed and visibly synchronizes its shot changes to audible beats.

answer_sheet.Required imagery: Neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections in a city at night.
answer_sheet.Music source and style: Create an original upbeat electronic instrumental bed; the specific tempo and instruments are your call.
answer_sheet.Editing: Cut between the city shots on the music's beat.
answer_sheet.Voice and text: No talking, singing or added text. Incidental signage is fine.

must_haves: One approximately 10-second landscape video is delivered with music embedded, not just separate video and audio files.
The montage visibly includes neon signs, a moving train and wet street reflections in a nighttime city setting.
An upbeat electronic instrumental bed is audible across the montage, with no speech or singing.
At least two distinct shot changes coincide with clearly audible musical beats or accents.
There are no added titles, captions or subtitles.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a polished 10-second widescreen cinematic night-city montage, with synchronized ORIGINAL upbeat instrumental electronic music. No dialogue, talking, singing, vocal samples, narration, captions, titles, logos or added text. Neon signage is environmental abstract glowing shapes without readable words. Rain-soaked contemporary city at night, vivid cyan and magenta neon, deep blacks, realistic filmic textures. Edit six shots with hard cuts exactly on strong music beats at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 and 9 seconds: 0–2s close tracking shot past luminous neon signs; 2–4s dynamic side view of a passing elevated commuter train with lit windows; 4–6s low macro-like street-level tracking shot of neon reflections shimmering in wet asphalt and puddles; 6–8s wider night-city shot as the train glides through the neon streetscape; 8–9s tight neon sign detail; 9–10s wet street reflections rippling under colorful city lights, ending cleanly on a musical hit. Maintain coherent urban setting and complementary neon colors across shots. Audio: compose a new upbeat electronic instrumental bed at 120 BPM, bright catchy synth arpeggios, punchy four-on-the-floor kick, crisp claps and hi-hats, warm energetic bass, no vocals whatsoever. Start the beat immediately and align every visual cut with the beat. Music prominent, no distracting ambient noise. Fit a complete miniature musical phrase into exactly 10 seconds, ending with a clean final accent rather than an abrupt mid-note cutoff.
